claim: The New York Legislature passed S3100A in June 2023, which would have banned nearly all non-compete agreements.
evidence: New York Governor Kathy Hochul vetoed Senate Bill S3100A, a bill passed by both houses of the legislature in June, that would prohibit all non-compete agreements.
excerpt:
New York Governor Kathy Hochul vetoed Senate Bill S3100A, a bill passed by both houses of the legislature in June, that would prohibit all non-compete agreements.

Senator Sean Ryan, who sponsored Senate Bill S3100A, has indicated that non-compete legislation will be reintroduced in 2024. Presumably, a new effort to enact non-compete legislation will take into account the significant problems with the 2023 bill, heed Governor Hochul’s focus on “middle-class and low-wage earners,” and reach a sensible compromise.
